title: OQPSK Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using OQPSK method, 1 input, 1 output, {Pulse shape} sets Filtering pulse shape Half; {Input type}, {Symbol mapping} sets the signal constellation bit, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase of zeroth point of signal, {View Constellation} sets the option to plot reference constellation, {Rolloff factor} sets the raised cosine filter rolloff factor, {Filter span (in symbols)} sets the filter length, {Filter numerator}, {Filter Denominator}, {Samples per symbol} sets the number of samples per symbol, {Rate options} sets the processing rate option Enforce single-rate and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input data integer column vector | bit column vector

params.name: Symbol mapping
params.values: Signal constellation bit mapping Gray (default) | Binary | custom 4-element numeric vector of integers with values from 0 to 3

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase of zeroth point of signal constellation 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: View Constellation
params.values: Option to plot reference constellation button

params.name: Pulse shape
params.values: Filtering pulse shape Half sine (default) | Normal raised cosine | Root raised cosine | Custom

params.name: Rolloff factor
params.values: Raised cosine filter rolloff factor 0.2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Number of samples per symbol 4 (default) | positive even integer

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Processing rate option Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing
